description: This Java source file implements a GLSurfaceView.Renderer that renders a textured rotating triangle using OpenGL ES 2.0 on Android. It manages shader compilation, texture loading from resources, and rendering logic including transformations and drawing.

classes.name: GLES20TriangleRenderer
classes.description: A renderer class for drawing a textured, rotating triangle using OpenGL ES 2.0 on Android.

methods.name: onDrawFrame
methods.description: Clears the screen and draws the textured triangle with current transformations.

methods.name: onSurfaceChanged
methods.description: Adjusts viewport and projection matrix when surface dimensions change.

methods.name: onSurfaceCreated
methods.description: Initializes shaders, program, and texture resources when surface is created.

methods.name: loadShader
methods.description: Compiles an OpenGL shader of given type from source code.

methods.name: createProgram
methods.description: Links vertex and fragment shaders into a shader program.

methods.name: checkGlError
methods.description: Checks for OpenGL errors and throws an exception if any are found.
